messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy started: canary 'new-proxy-route' -> prod (5% traffic). PR: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/4823 · initiating rollout.

sara: Seeing a spike in 502s from prompt-router on canary hosts, spike started ~2m after rollout :thinking_face:

matt: paging oncall · @natalie are you around? paging now. incident-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-879 opened for prompt-router 502 spike.

natalie: oncall here, looking. Link to logs: https://monitoring/redwood/alerts/PD-879

lina: Rolling logs show `kvcache miss` + `incompatible-kernel` errors on canary group-3. Errors correlate with model_variant=v2-exp.

carlos: Metrics: 5xx went from 0.2% -> 6.8% for route /v1/prompt/proxy (canary slice). P95 latency up 4x. Customer-facing errors visible on a few large tenants (acme, fastapps).

matt: this is bad for prod traffic. We need an immediate kill-switch on the feature flag that routes to new-proxy-route. Steps in playbook: 1) flip FF to stable-route, 2) divert canary traffic, 3) monitor.

lina: I can flip. Running ffctl:

```
ffctl toggle new_proxy_route off --env=prod --wait
```

deploy-bot: Executing FF toggle request via controlplane: request_id=cp-99321

sara: @lina pls confirm after API returns success.

lina: API returned 200 OK · flag new_proxy_route set to false

deploy-bot: Feature-flag changed: new_proxy_route=false · rollout target: all production shards

carlos: Observability: starting to see error rate drop on canary within 30s. P95 trending back toward baseline.

natalie: Handoff note: I'm keeping the incident hot for 15m to verify no regression. @cs-bot please draft a short customer note for affected tenants.

cs-bot: Drafting customer message: "We observed increased errors for prompt routing affecting a small percentage of traffic. We reverted an experimental routing flag and services are returning to normal. We're investigating the root cause and will follow up." · sending to CS channel for review.

matt: Can we get a short blameless timeline? - 00:00 deploy started - 00:02 errors spike - 00:04 FF toggle off - 00:06 errors decreasing. Need postmortem input.

lina: Can confirm canary group-3 removed from new path, traffic rebalanced to stable-route. No further error classes in logs after 3m.

sara: Any customers opened support tickets? @cs-bot

cs-bot: Two tickets created by acme-support and fastapps-sre showing 502s; both auto-acknowledged and linked to PD-879.

natalie: Ok I'll run through the checklist: preserve logs, capture heap/profile snapshots from canary hosts, tag related traces, and schedule a 1hr blameless postmortem at 15:00 PT.

matt: Thanks everyone. Next actions: research kernel incompat (lina/carlos), check model_variant packaging (research), confirm rollback/patch plan if we find a root cause. I'll update exec summary after postmortem.

sara: Reaction: :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Incident PD-879 status: mitigated · assignee: natalie · severity: Sev2 · postmortem scheduled.

natalie: Closing note: monitoring for 30m then handoff to next oncall at 14:45 PT. If anything resurfaces, re-open PD-879.

carlos: Final metric snapshot before handoff: 5xx -> 0.3%, p95 latency back to 180ms baseline. No new customer reports in last 10m.

lina: Uploaded logs and kernel versions to the incident ticket: https://tickets.redwood/PD-879

matt: Thanks team — great quick coordination.
